category_title: Individuals with SIB masking social functions under standard assessment conditions
minimal_context: The student is in an activity room with access to moderately preferred toys while the therapist sits nearby reading a magazine.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Here are some toys for you to play with. I am going to sit over here and read my magazine.

STUDENT: (The student ignores the toys and begins scratching their arms, digging their nails into the skin.)

TUTOR: Please play with the toys.

STUDENT: (The student continues scratching and begins hitting their torso and legs with their fists.)

TUTOR: I am still reading my magazine, you can keep playing.

STUDENT: (The student escalates to hitting themselves in the head and banging their head against the surface of the table.)

options.A: Role-play and model ways for the student to use the moderately preferred toys and interact.
options.B: Apply protective procedures, such as canvas sleeves, noncontingently for the entirety of the session.
options.C: Use a 5-point visual scale matching numbers, colors, and faces to feeling words to check the student's emotions.
options.D: Provide costumes and props and allow the student to act out small plotlines during the session.
